description: Fluid mechanics decomposed. Boundary layer theory, drag types, turbulence models (RANS, LES, DNS), pipe flow + Moody chart, pump systems + NPSH, compressible flow (shock waves), open channel hydraulics.

sub_mechanisms.name: boundary_layer_concept
sub_mechanisms.definition: Thin layer near surface where viscous effects dominate. Outside: inviscid.
sub_mechanisms.why: Prandtl 1904. Foundation of modern fluid mechanics. Drag, heat transfer, separation all originate here.

sub_mechanisms.name: boundary_layer_separation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Adverse pressure gradient causes BL to detach from surface. Wake forms.
sub_mechanisms.why: Form drag, stall (airfoil), bluff body wake. Streamlining reduces. Critical for efficiency.

sub_mechanisms.name: form_drag_friction_drag
sub_mechanisms.definition: Form: pressure × frontal area (bluff bodies). Friction: shear on surface.
sub_mechanisms.why: Total drag decomposition. Streamlining converts form to friction (lower total). Aerodynamic design philosophy.

sub_mechanisms.name: lift_circulation_Kutta
sub_mechanisms.definition: Kutta-Joukowski: L' = ρv·Γ. Circulation around airfoil generates lift.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of aerodynamics. Tangential velocity difference top vs bottom = pressure difference = lift. Standard derivation.

sub_mechanisms.name: Moody_chart
sub_mechanisms.definition: Friction factor vs Reynolds + relative roughness. Three regions: laminar, transition, turbulent.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard pipe flow design. Pump head from friction loss. Roughness depends on pipe material + condition.

sub_mechanisms.name: NPSH_pump_cavitation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Net Positive Suction Head. NPSHA (available) > NPSHR (required) to avoid cavitation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Pump installation critical. NPSHA from system: suction pressure - vapor pressure. NPSHR from pump curve. Standard pump sizing.

sub_mechanisms.name: RANS_turbulence_modeling
sub_mechanisms.definition: Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes. Average quantities; model Reynolds stresses. k-ε, k-ω.
sub_mechanisms.why: Workhorse industrial CFD. Time-averaged. Various closure models. Good for design; missed transient phenomena.

sub_mechanisms.name: LES_large_eddy_simulation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Resolve large eddies; model small. Trade-off between accuracy + cost.
sub_mechanisms.why: Aeroacoustics, combustion, unsteady aero. ~100× cost of RANS. Increasing as compute available. Modern.

sub_mechanisms.name: DNS_direct_numerical_simulation
sub_mechanisms.why: Research only at low-moderate Re. Computational cost ~Re³. Validates RANS + LES models.

sub_mechanisms.name: shock_waves_compressible
sub_mechanisms.definition: Sudden discontinuity at M > 1. Normal vs oblique. Properties change across.
sub_mechanisms.why: Supersonic flow. Drag rise, pressure ratio, temperature rise. Bow shock on supersonic aircraft. Rocket nozzles.

sub_mechanisms.name: Mach_number_regimes
sub_mechanisms.why: Different physics each regime. Transonic: shock formation challenging. Hypersonic: chemistry + radiation matter.

sub_mechanisms.name: open_channel_flow
sub_mechanisms.definition: Free surface. Froude number Fr = v/√(gL). Subcritical (Fr<1) vs supercritical.
sub_mechanisms.why: Rivers, drainage, spillways. Hydraulic jump where supercritical to subcritical. Different from pipe flow (pressure-driven).

derivation_rules.name: boundary_layer_theory_simplifies_NS
then: boundary layer + outer inviscid analysis simpler than full NS
derivation_rules.why: Prandtl's insight. Decouple thin viscous region from inviscid outer. Foundation of practical fluid mechanics. Aerodynamic design relies on this.

derivation_rules.name: streamlining_reduces_drag_via_BL_management
if: body is streamlined to delay BL separation
derivation_rules.why: Sphere vs teardrop at same area: 10× drag difference. Streamlining keeps BL attached → no wake. Standard aerodynamic philosophy.

derivation_rules.name: NPSH_violation_causes_cavitation
derivation_rules.why: Local pressure < vapor pressure → vapor bubbles → collapse on impeller → damage. NPSHA > NPSHR with margin. Standard.

derivation_rules.name: RANS_default_LES_critical_only
then: RANS is default; LES where critical
derivation_rules.why: Cost: RANS hours, LES days. RANS sufficient for most design. LES for unsteady, acoustics, finely-resolved phenomena. Standard practice.

derivation_rules.name: compressibility_M_above_0_3
derivation_rules.why: Below: incompressible approximation. Above: density variations significant. Aircraft cruise: compressible required. Standard threshold.
